title: Execute temporary power/toughness switching for a bounded switch_pt atom

evidence.fact: Continuous effects model Layer 7b setting but have no temporary P/T-swap representation.
Ability-effect dispatch has pump variants but no switch_pt case.
Power and toughness are independently read through the effect manager; the capability must preserve layering and end-of-turn expiry.

required_behavior: A switch_pt ability swaps a creature's current power and toughness until end of turn without mutating its printed base values.
It supports exactly the pre-proven self, target-creature, and each-creature scopes.
It composes with existing Layer 7b and additive modifiers and expires through the existing end-of-turn cleanup path.
The discriminating test proves the target's 2/5 becomes 5/2, an unaffected creature remains unchanged, and cleanup restores 2/5.
gates: gofmt -d backend/game/effects.go backend/game/card.go backend/game/ability_effects.go backend/game/switch_pt_test.go produces no output
git diff --name-only contains only the allowed paths

execution.selection_reason: This is bounded Engine work with a concrete Layer-7 execution invariant; Sol is used for the semantic implementation, not Qwen's cheap capability-decision route.

on_failure: Return an immutable receipt with raw telemetry and either NEEDS_PRIMITIVE, REFACTOR_FIRST, SPLIT_REQUIRED, or one constrained proposal. Do not broaden to unrelated P/T mechanics.
